label: Poultry and captive birds identification and traceability
description: Poultry, chickens, turkeys, ducks, geese, game birds, and other avian livestock identification using leg bands, flock records, holding registration, movement documentation, and housing records. Covers traceability, welfare, biosecurity, egg and meat production, and disease control including Avian Influenza, Newcastle Disease, and Salmonella.
